verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents a draft/publish flow versioning mechanism, including a sensitive-project approval gate requiring PUBLISH_SENSITIVE_FLOW_ACCESS before changes go live, which mirrors a basic dev-to-prod promotion gate. However there is no evidence of git/source-control integration, exportable version history, or distinct multiple environments (dev/staging/prod) beyond a single project's draft vs published state.  missing for 10: source control integration (git sync/export), explicit multi-environment promotion (dev/staging/prod), version history/rollback tooling.
